QuestInfo.name: Gathering Evidence
QuestInfo.0: What you fought inside was not a creature or machine, but something far more mysterious. Is there a way to find out what it is?\r\n
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the monsters on the 2nd floor and gather any materials that can be analyzed. Collect 10 to make the analysis easier.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered all the materials. Now ask #b#p1531007##k to analyze them.

0.msg: What did I fight just now? It wasn't a machine or a lifeform.

1.msg: Could it have been some kind of... dust monster? There were rumors about these at a nearby school.\r\n

2.msg: Wait, I hear something upstairs. I should check it out.

3.msg: If that's what you think... If the monsters drop something, collect 10 of them for me, okay?\r\n

0.msg: I don't want you to stay there too long.\r\n(Go upstairs in the school and collect 10 of whatever the Motes drop.)\r\n
